gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.search_help: Allow OpenAI native web search using the owner's ChatGPT subscription. Save applies to future requests. Unsupported accounts or models report an error without falling back to DeepSeek. Click source links in game chat to open them.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.search_no_sourc: Online lookup completed; no source links were provided for this response.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.summary_help: Request a reasoning summary and show it in the maid's thinking bubble during streaming. Only the final answer is spoken. Enabled by default; summaries may not appear on every response.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.effort_help: Click to cycle; Save applies this to future requests. Higher effort usually takes longer and uses more quota. Off becomes Low on Astra / 6.1 Sol; Maximum becomes Extra high on GPT-5.5. No summary is requested when reasoning is effectively off.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.checking_models: Reading and verifying models; this may take a few moments…
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.discovery_help: Refresh verifies unlisted GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna and adds successful models. Each check sends a short request and uses a small amount of subscription quota.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.invalid_host: Enter user@server without spaces or shell operators
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.logout_detail: This revokes the current session and clears its models. Maids using this subscription will be unable to chat.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for browser authorization; updates automatically
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.remote_help: Remote server: enter the SSH host, copy the command and run it in your local terminal. Keep it running, then return to the account page and sign in. Close SSH after authorization.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.local_help: Singleplayer and local servers can sign in without SSH.
gui.touhou_aifun.chatgpt.copied: SSH command copied. Run locally, then return here to sign in.
